init_BaseModule: create a BaseModule subclass with an init_cfg dict to control weight initialization strategy
call_init_weights: call init_weights on a BaseModule instance to initialize all parameters and log initialization info
check_is_init: check the is_init property of a BaseModule to see if init_weights has already been called
create_Sequential: build a Sequential module with child modules and an init_cfg dict for per-module initialization
create_ModuleList: create a ModuleList containing multiple nn modules with a shared init_cfg initialization config
